Because neighboring fans spinning in the same direction create opposing airflow between them, turbulence increases and heat dissipation drops. GIGABYTE makes the adjacent fans spin in opposite directions so the airflow between them moves the same way, reducing turbulence and increasing airflow pressure. GIGABYTE’s excellent heat transfer design. They also extend over the VRAM via a large metal plate contact to ensure proper cooling. GeForce Experience. 3D ACTIVE FAN: The 3D Active Fan provides semi-passive cooling, keeping the fans off when the GPU is under low load or in a low-power game. This lets gamers enjoy complete silence when the system is light-loaded or idle. Game Ready Drivers. COMPOSITE HEAT-PIPES: Composite heat pipes combine thermal conductivity and phase transition to manage heat transfer efficiently between two solid interfaces, increasing cooling capacity.
